note: Sherman County recreation area 1 mi W of Loup City (formerly Bowman Lake SRA; the state was authorized to convey it to the county in 2011): a 20-acre lake beside the Middle Loup River. Basic drive-in sites with picnic shelters, tables and grills sit on gravel loops in the trees between the lake and the river. --Claude
summary: No groups confirmed: the county runs it but posts no camping page, and NGPC no longer lists it. OWNERSHIP looks wrong - state -> local (Sherman County; statute 90-275 authorized the transfer, the county board runs it, it is off the NGPC 2025 grid). Name, website and the 'state park entry permit' line are outdated. Pin OK on the camp loops; not waterfront kept.
flags: OWNERSHIP state -> local proposed (by hand): Neb. Rev. Stat. 90-275 (LB207, 2011) authorized Game and Parks to convey 'Bowman State Recreation Area' to Sherman County 'for public park purposes'; the Sherman County Board's 2023-03-28 minutes advertise mowing bids for 'Bowman Lake Recreation Area' and record a county Bowman Lake Advisory Committee; Google's listing is 'Bowman Lake - Sherman County Recreation Area'; a 2016 NGPC magazine snippet says 'owned and maintained by Sherman County'; it is absent from NGPC's 2025 rates grid. With ownership state the state:NE policy would wrongly apply the NGPC entry permit and ReserveAmerica booking assumptions.
NAME: suggest 'Bowman Lake Recreation Area' (county board minutes) or Google's 'Bowman Lake - Sherman County Recreation Area' in place of 'Bowman Lake State Recreation Area'.

WEBSITE: stored https://outdoornebraska.gov/location/bowman-lake/ is NGPC's and likely retired (unread - blocked). No county camping page exists. PRESENCE is thin: Google 4.2 from 10 reviews and the county's minutes; no operator page states camping, fees or rules. Under the public-campground ladder this is weak but it is plainly an open county park with camping per directories - keep with that caveat, AWH's call.
FEES unknown: nothing official. Campendium shows $0 (aggregator). Entry permit: the note's 'State park entry permit required' is probably obsolete after the county transfer - removed from the note.
BOOKING (derived FCFS) and hookups (none), sites 10, vault toilets: all note-derived, no operator source to confirm; left as stored.

PIN OK: stored 41.27577,-98.99176 is at the junction of the camp loops among the picnic shelters, south-west of the lake's south arm. Google's 41.27834,-98.99276 is on the open water of the lake (~300 m N) - don't use it.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the shelter sites sit in trees between the lake and the river. The lake side is cut off by the gravel dike road along the lake's south-west arm; the Middle Loup is ~60-120 m west through trees and a sandbar. A few south-loop sites near the sandy river access may glimpse the river, but nothing legible earns *view; unsure, so no upgrade.
SAND RULE passes: camping is on gravel loops on grass; a sandy track at the south end leads to the river sandbar, but no campsite depends on it.
FIT for 23 ft: gravel loop roads with pull-ins beside shelters; looks fine on imagery, no posted limit found.

NOTE CLEANED: replaced 'Small NGPC SRA' (operator now Sherman County), dropped 'About 10 basic/primitive drive-in campsites (no hookups)' (sites.count, hookups), 'vault toilet' (facilities), 'FCFS, no reservations' (booking) and 'State park entry permit required' (contradicted by the county transfer).
